title: CT annotation audit with localized anatomical defects
question: A solver must detect localized mask defects while accepting plausible annotations on real scans with coverage and pathology variation; global label presence, side and tissue summaries are insufficient.
prior_findings: Localized changes preserve plausible whole-mask shape and tissue class, but the fresh Terra/max run timed out after 1800 seconds with its empty starter unchanged. Genuine short-horizon difficulty is not established.
next_action: Preserve the batch timeout as inconclusive. The completed single-patient screen identifies dicom-audit-32 as the lead and dicom-audit-83 as a second reviewed miss; source holds remain for cases 46 and 61. See the separate resource benchmark before any newly frozen design.
